summary: Subject⇄Teacher coverage matrix + bulk-assign — full backend + frontend regression on the deployed preview URL. BACKEND: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_subject_coverage.py = 12/12 PASS in 3.03s — coverage shape (subjects/total_teachers/orphan_count) is correct; bulk-assign is idempotent (re-run added=0) and returns assigned_teacher_ids+added+removed; invalid teacher_id is rejected with HTTP 400 and 'Invalid teacher_ids' detail; unknown subject_id → 404; replace:true is authoritative (removes subject from teachers NOT in payload, scoped to the school); unassign-teacher pulls subject from the user, and an unknown teacher_id under the same school returns 404; RBAC: GET /subjects/coverage, POST /bulk-assign-teachers AND POST /unassign-teacher all return 403 for teacher and accounts roles. FRONTEND (principal@sunrise.edu/School@123) on /school/classes — (a) coverage-matrix renders with 5 subject rows + 5 bulk-assign-btn-<sid>; orphan-<sid> badges = 0 (DEMO seed has 100% coverage); (b) clicking bulk-assign-btn opens bulk-assign-modal showing 8 teacher rows with pre-checked count = current assignees (2 for English); (c) bulk-assign-search filters live (typing 'priya' → 1 row); (d) bulk-assign-select-all checks all 8, bulk-assign-clear-all clears to 0; (e) toggling bulk-assign-replace + Submit fires POST /api/academic/subjects/<sid>/bulk-assign-teachers with `{teacher_ids:[…8 ids…], replace:true}` (verified in request body) → 200 with added=6,removed=0; modal closes; toast 'English: 6 added' shown; (f) coverage chip remove button (coverage-remove-<sid>-<tid>) opens browser confirm → on accept POSTs /unassign-teacher/<tid> → 200 and matrix refreshes. RBAC FRONTEND: priya@sunrise.edu/Teacher@123 is redirected from /school/classes to /teacher (school_admin route guard); no coverage-matrix, no bulk-assign-btn nodes rendered; direct fetch of /api/academic/subjects/coverage from teacher session returns 403. All acceptance criteria from the spec are satisfied.
critical_code_review_comments: academic.py:120-153 (coverage): correctly excludes _id projection and uses sort by name; orphan_count is recomputed from rows rather than queried — good single source of truth. total_teachers counts is_active teachers only which is the right denominator for 'active coverage'.

academic.py:156-209 (bulk-assign): de-duplicates teacher_ids with dict.fromkeys preserving order — nice touch; the validate-then-update pattern means a partial-bad payload fails atomically with 400 instead of silently dropping invalid ids. $addToSet guarantees idempotency. replace:true uses {$nin: teacher_ids, subjects: subject_id} so the $pull only touches teachers currently holding the subject — efficient and scoped to the school via school_id filter. No race condition concerns under typical admin usage.

academic.py:212-232 (unassign): returns 404 only when the teacher document is not matched in this school (matched_count==0) — semantically correct. removed:0 (matched but had no such subject) is silently OK which matches REST DELETE semantics. Comment correctly flags the downstream inconsistency where a teacher can end up with subjects=[] (teacher-create guard added in iter13 enforces non-empty, but unassign can leave zero). Acceptable — UI warns admins.

ClassesPage.jsx CoverageMatrix: uses tenant subject ids in data-testids (coverage-row-<sid>, coverage-teacher-<sid>-<tid>) — stable for automation. Chip remove uses window.confirm — works but a styled <Modal> would be more on-brand; not a blocker.

ClassesPage.jsx BulkAssignModal: pre-checks teachers already assigned and shows 'Currently assigned' badge — exactly per spec. Submitting with replace=true correctly omits the teachers that were unchecked from the payload so the backend can $pull them. Search is client-side, case-insensitive — fine for school-scale teacher lists (<200).

Minor: the success toast string 'English: 6 added' relies on response.added; when added=0 AND removed=0 (idempotent re-run) the toast still fires — consider message 'No changes' for that case. Not a regression.
